notes: The leading «25 -» is the text's own number (the context carries 10); not read as part of a name.
«وعن يونس بن يعقوب» opens a second isnad after «جعفر بن محمد .»; the saying follows the second route, so the first route names no saying of its own. Two groups, not one, because of the «. وعن» break.
«قراءة عليه من كتابه» describes how the report was read and is left out.

fixes.reason: RWY reads جعفر بن محمد and يونس بن يعقوب as one route; the text separates them with «. وعن», so this reading has two groups.

evidence.quote: وعن يونس بن يعقوب عن سالم المكي
